subject: design/brainstorm-record-model
statement: merge freezes a record uniformly — the generalization of the PRD's "frozen when the PRD it feeds merges" to the two self-committed verdicts. Post-merge, a record changes by no mechanism at all: no amendments, no supersession machinery — a reopened idea is a **new record** whose header cites the frozen predecessor (resolves PRD Q4, leaning as recorded there). Orientation (FR-2) must surface cited prior records and their rulings, which is what makes "zero re-asked questions" hold across reopenings without unfreezing anything.
